notes: BW25113 biofilm grown ~36 h in a microfluidic chamber in M63B1 at 37 C; periphery cells FACS-sorted. PpyrLBI_high/low are cells sorted by a pyrLBI promoter reporter (taken as a reporter strain, reference genotype, controls); delta sapD is a deletion. Library method miniBac-seq (custom low-input method, details only in the paper): assay_class total_rnaseq is assumed from 'total RNA' and should be checked. M63B1 carbon source not stated. rRNA removal not stated.
